Alice — great to hear the numbers and thanks for the procurement heads-up. Quick recap from our side and how we map to that $10k–$40k envelope: 

Summary (pilot baseline)
- Estimated tokens/month (baseline): 250M–350M (including experiments)
- Pricing options we discussed:
  • Pay-as-you-go (no commit): $210 / 1M tokens (list)
  • 3–6 month reserved slab (recommended for pilot): $150–170 / 1M tokens depending on volume commit and early-payment terms

Mapping to Brightwing band:
- $10k/mo -> ~47M tokens @ $210/1M (too low for your baseline)
- $20k/mo -> ~133M tokens @ $150/1M (still below baseline)
- $25k/mo -> ~167M tokens @ $150/1M
- $40k/mo -> ~266M tokens @ $150/1M (close to baseline lower end)

Procurement trigger: anything billed >$25k/mo will require a PO and standard SOW addendum — we can support a 30-day lead time and accelerate if needed. Attached is a simple spreadsheet with permutations (redwood-pricing-estimate-brightwing-20261118.xlsx) and a one-page SOW outline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment call (30m) with Brightwing procurement to confirm PO thresholds and payment terms — can you share 2 windows next week?
2) If procurement wants a reserved slab, we can put together a 3-month pilot offer at $160 / 1M with an early-payment credit to hit $150 / 1M effective (requires a minimum commit of 200M tokens/mo).
3) Technical kickoff for KV/caching plan once contract is in flight.

Looping in Karthik (cc) to confirm finance/ops gating and Lauren for commercial approval if we need to drop below $150/1M for pilot.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — quick internal note on procurement and finance constraints: 

- PO threshold alignment: finance confirms we can accept monthly invoices up to $30k without reserved-commit legal changes; above $30k we need an amendment for net-45 on top of PO. That means the customer's stated $25k trigger is in the flexible zone, but their 30-day lead-time may require contract slack.
- Discount guardrails for pilot: Presales/finance approve up to a 20% discount off list for time-limited pilots if the minimum commit is documented (200M tokens/mo for 3 months). That maps to ~$168 / 1M tokens list -> ~$134 / 1M effective. We should avoid setting expectation below $130 / 1M without additional sign-off.

Action items for Marissa: please confirm if Brightwing can commit to 200M tokens/mo for an initial 3-month reserved slab. If yes, we'll draft a pilot SOW with the credit terms and send to procurement. If no, we keep pay-as-you-go or smaller reserved slab at higher per-M token price.
